title.en: The Cold War · Decolonization, Vietnam and negotiations
title.zh: 冷战 · 非殖民化、越南与谈判

summary.en: Connect postwar rivalry with Korean and Vietnamese wars, Bandung, non-alignment, the Cuban crisis and the unequal 1989 transitions.
summary.zh: 把战后对抗同朝鲜与越南战争、万隆、不结盟、古巴危机及不尽相同的1989年转变联系起来。

questions.en: How did anticolonial and non-aligned governments pursue aims that did not fit a simple two-bloc account?
questions.zh: 反殖民与不结盟政府如何追求不能归入简单两阵营叙述的目标？

questions.en: Why are the 1973 agreement, the end of fighting in 1975 and formal unification in 1976 different milestones?
questions.zh: 为什么1973年协议、1975年战事结束与1976年正式统一是不同节点？

questions.en: What can a U.S. military chronology and a report on Vietnamese scholarship each show or leave out?
questions.zh: 美国军方编年与越南研究会议报道各能呈现什么，又各可能遗漏什么？

activity.en: Compare the dates and source perspectives for 1954, 1961, 1962, 1968, 1973, 1975 and 1989. Identify one place where a single “end of the Cold War” date obscures a local history.
activity.zh: 比较1954、1961、1962、1968、1973、1975与1989年的日期和来源视角；指出一个被单一“冷战结束”日期遮蔽的地方历史。

evidencePolicy: Editorial sequence, not a travel path. Source notes distinguish U.S.-centered chronology, Vietnamese scholarship and non-aligned interpretations.

title.en: Atlantic connections · Exchange, enslavement and resistance
title.zh: 大西洋联系 · 交流、奴役与抵抗

summary.en: Read Indigenous Caribbean continuity, biological and material exchange, forced crossings, plantation work and resistance together.
summary.zh: 并读加勒比原住民延续、生物与物质交流、强迫横渡、种植园劳动和抵抗。

questions.en: How did plants, pathogens, people and practices move in more than one direction, and who was coerced?
questions.zh: 植物、病原体、人群和实践如何沿多个方向移动，谁遭到了强制？

questions.en: How do voyage records and Mary Prince’s narrated, edited testimony reveal different parts of slavery’s history?
questions.zh: 航行档案与经口述和编辑的玛丽·普林斯证言，各揭示奴役史的哪些不同方面？

questions.en: What do Taíno continuity, Palmares and Haiti show about survival and resistance?
questions.zh: 泰诺人的延续、帕尔马雷斯和海地显示了哪些幸存与抵抗？

activity.en: Open the forced-crossings network and compare two records. Explain why a schematic connection and an estimated voyage count cannot represent any one person’s full journey.
activity.zh: 打开强迫横渡网络并比较两条记录，解释为何网络示意和航次数量估算不能代表任何一个人的完整经历。

evidencePolicy: Editorial comparison. The linked route is a schematic network, not an individual itinerary; Indigenous and descendant communities continue.

title.en: African and Pacific connections · Languages and evidence
title.zh: 非洲与太平洋联系 · 语言与证据

summary.en: Compare Bantu-language models, early Austronesian hypotheses, Lapita sites and later Madagascar evidence without treating languages or pottery as political borders.
summary.zh: 比较班图语模型、南岛语早期假说、拉皮塔遗址与后来的马达加斯加证据，不把语言或陶器当作政治疆界。

questions.en: What can language relationships, archaeological objects, crops and oral histories each contribute? What can none establish alone?
questions.zh: 语言关系、考古物品、作物与口述历史各能提供什么？哪些事情不能由任何单一材料证明？

questions.en: Why does an early research window not imply that a language or community ended?
questions.zh: 为什么早期研究窗口不表示一种语言或社群已经结束？

questions.en: What does a representative point leave unresolved about journeys and prior inhabitants?
questions.zh: 代表地点对航行和先前居民留下哪些未解决问题？

activity.en: Compare one Bantu model with the Austronesian and Madagascar sources. List each source’s evidence, dated scope and one interpretation that remains uncertain.
activity.zh: 比较一项班图语模型与南岛语、马达加斯加来源，列出各自的证据、年代范围和一项仍不确定的解释。

evidencePolicy: Editorial comparison of distinct processes, not one shared migration or route. Approximate dates and source disagreements remain visible.
